summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a comprehensive lecture on Surah Ali Imran, focusing on the concept of Jihad as presented in the Quran. He explains that Jihad encompasses two primary forms: defending truth through knowledge, speech, and the tongue (al-jihad bil qawli wal lisan), and physical defense when necessary (al-jihad bis sayfi). Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that every Muslim bears responsibility for defending their religion according to their capacity, and warns against hesitation and doubt (shubha) that can gradually erode one's commitment to Islam. He uses vivid examples, such as the lion and gazelle, to illustrate how hesitation weakens resolve, and urges the community to commit fully to Islam without wavering. The lecture concludes with an announcement about the Muslim Community Center's acquisition of additional property to expand Rahmah Academy.
suggested_title: Surah Ali Imran: Understanding Jihad and Full Commitment to Islam
